blocks.text: Esters neeche diye gaye tareeqon se banaye ja sakte hain.
i. Carboxylic acids aur alcohol ke reaction se
Carboxylic acids acidic medium mein alcohols se react kar ke ester banate hain. Is reaction ko Fischer's esterification kehte hain. Maslan:

blocks.alt: Propanoic acid, CH3-CH2-C(=O)-OH, + ethanol, CH3-CH2-OH, equilibrium arrows par H+, se ethyl propanoate, CH3-CH2-C(=O)-O-CH2-CH3, + H2O.
blocks.caption: Propanoic acid aur ethanol se ethyl propanoate (kitab ke page 113 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Propanoic acid (3 carbon) aur ethanol (2 carbon) H⁺ ki presence (maujoodgi) mein ethyl propanoate aur paani dete hain. Ester ke naam mein pehle alcohol wala hissa (ethyl) aur phir acid wala hissa (propanoate) aata hai. Equilibrium ke arrows batate hain ke reaction reversible hai (ulat bhi sakta hai).

blocks.alt: R-C(=O)-OH + H-O-R, equilibrium arrows par H+, se R-C(=O)-OR + H2O. Do arrows 'Bond Cleavage': acid ka C-OH bond aur alcohol ka H-O bond.
blocks.caption: General esterification, tootne wale bonds ke saath (kitab ke page 113 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: 'Bond Cleavage' ke arrows batate hain ke acid ka C–OH bond aur alcohol ka O–H bond toot'ta hai. Acid ka OH aur alcohol ka H mil kar paani bante hain, aur alcohol ka O–R carbonyl carbon se jur kar ester banata hai.
iii. Acyl chlorides aur alcohols ke reaction se

Acyl chlorides alcohols se vigorously (zor se) react kar ke esters banate hain. Yeh reactions complete (mukammal) ho jate hain aur carboxylic acid aur alcohol ke reaction ki tarah equilibrium mixture nahi banate.

blocks.alt: Ethanoyl chloride, CH3-C(=O)-Cl, + ethanol, CH3-CH2-O-H, se ethyl ethanoate, CH3-C(=O)-O-CH2-CH3, + HCl, one-way arrow.
blocks.caption: Ethanoyl chloride aur ethanol se ethyl ethanoate (kitab ke page 113 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ka label 'ethylethanoate' aik word mein chhapa hai; ester ka naam do words mein likha jata hai: ethyl ethanoate.
iv. Acyl chlorides aur phenol ke reaction se
Acyl chloride ko phenol ke saath halka garam karne par phenyl esters bante hain. Yeh reaction Chapter 22 mein aa chuka hai. Maslan: C₆H₅COCl + C₆H₅OH → C₆H₅COOC₆H₅ (phenyl benzoate) + HCl.

blocks.title: Numbering ke baare mein
blocks.text: Kitab ne tareeqon ko i, iii aur iv number diya hai; ii chhapa hi nahi. Is liye yahan bhi wahi numbers rakhe gaye hain.

blocks.prompt: Ester banane ke liye carboxylic acid ki jagah aksar acyl chloride kyun istemal hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Acyl chloride room temperature par jaldi react karta hai aur reaction mukammal ho jata hai (HCl nikal jata hai), jab ke carboxylic acid aur alcohol sirf equilibrium mixture dete hain.

items: Acid + alcohol ⇌ ester + paani (H⁺, Fischer's esterification): acid ka C–OH aur alcohol ka O–H toot'ta hai.
Acyl chloride + alcohol → ester + HCl: tez aur mukammal.
Acyl chloride + phenol (garam) → phenyl ester + HCl.
